title: fix: make Grok 4.6 Quest-accessible
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Sets `grok-4.6` to `paidOnly: false`, allowing Quest Pollen while preserving its Azure route, aliases, 0.75 multiplier, pricing, and capabilities.
- Adds registry-contract coverage and proves the model is visible to an authenticated caller with no paid balance.
- E2E request `1f8f3c49-64c1-4b04-ae41-26c4ae5011b0`: pack balance 0, Azure HTTP 200, exact reply, and a $0.001218 debit entirely from Quest Pollen.
- Staging Tinybird recorded one billed row with provider `azure`, meter `v1:meter:tier`, 17 prompt, 10 completion, and 255 reasoning tokens; focused tests, Biome, and Gen typecheck pass.

gist.headline: Grok joins the Quest garden
gist.blurb: Grok 4.6 can now run on Quest-earned Pollen, even when the paid balance is a perfectly respectable zero. Azure keeps doing the serving; the hive simply opened the right gate.
gist.summary: Updated the text-model registry so grok-4.6 has paidOnly: false, allowing authenticated callers to use its existing Azure route, aliases, 0.75 multiplier, pricing, and capabilities with Quest Pollen.
gist.impact: Developers with no paid Pollen balance can now call grok-4.6 using Quest-earned Pollen; an end-to-end request successfully routed through Azure and billed $0.001218 entirely from Quest balance.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Grok 4.6 as a friendly glowing retro terminal in a cozy garden gate scene, with Quest Pollen represented by luminous flower-seeds flowing through an open gate into the terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny questing satchel, should be checking the gate mechanism while code-plants and a small Azure-blue cloud-shaped sign suggest the preserved Azure route without turning the scene corporate.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden gateway where Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears a tiny questing satchel and opens a gate for glowing Pollen flower-seeds to reach a friendly retro terminal labeled “GROK 4.6”; code-plants bloom beside a small soft-blue cloud sign for the Azure route. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
